headline: Session done — easy run solid, strides underdelivered
summary: 45min rolling block landed right in the prescribed band (avg 145bpm within 138-152, 139m D+ on ~150m target terrain), RPE 4/feel 3 — exactly the intended easy stimulus. But the back end shows only one short hard effort (8m35s @162bpm) rather than the 6x30s Z4-Z5 strides at 170-182bpm with 180+ spm called for; cadence averaged just 78.7 spm for the whole run, well under the 180+ target for those reps. Load logged at 32 vs the 50 estimated, consistent with the strides being missed or diluted rather than a bad watch read. No pain or ITB signal reported — feel 3, HRR 34bpm is clean. This doesn't hurt tomorrow, but it's a second instance this week (after Mon/Wed's dropped sessions) of hard work being watered down while easy/moderate volume holds — worth naming before it becomes a pattern into Saturday's key 2h45 session.
flags: Grey-zone drift watch: this is at least the third session this week where a prescribed hard element (strides, threshold cap) under-delivered while aerobic volume was held or exceeded — track whether Sat's key session gets full compliance.
Cadence 78.7 spm overall is low for a session with intended 180+ spm strides; if strides were attempted, they weren't logged as distinct high-cadence efforts in the data.
suggestedChange: Consider flagging to Alberto directly whether the 6x30s hill strides were actually run — if skipped again, worth deciding whether to fold that stimulus into Saturday's climb or let it go this week given Saturday is the priority.
